description: WhatsApp bot build by Árñóld Adez

SESSION_ID.description: Your WhatsApp session ID for ADEZ-XMD. Optional if you are using a stored session.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Your WhatsApp number without the + sign.

FORWARD_TARGET.description: Optional WhatsApp chat/channel JID to forward incoming messages to.

FORWARD_CHANNEL_JID.description: Optional alias for the forwarding target JID.

SKIP_COMMAND_FORWARD.description: Skip forwarding commands beginning with a dot.
